title: The C# public API for the AABB class is not equivalent to its counterpart in GDScript
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4-beta4, 4.3-stable.
- Not tested on versions prior to 4.3-stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - Windows 10.0.26100 - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.4692) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 Threads)

### Issue description

For the AABB object the public API does not correspond to the one that GDScript has for that version. While the GDScript API matches the one specified in the documentation, having the following methods...

> [Variant](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_variant.html#class-variant) intersects_ray(from: [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3), dir: [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3)) const 
> 
> Returns the first point where this bounding box and the given ray intersect, as a [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3). If no intersection occurs, returns null.
> 
> The ray begin at from, faces dir and extends towards infinity.
> 
> [Variant](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_variant.html#class-variant) intersects_segment(from: [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3), to: [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3)) const 
> 
> Returns the first point where this bounding box and the given segment intersect, as a [Vector3](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_vector3.html#class-vector3). If no intersection occurs, returns null.
> 
> The segment begins at from and ends at to.

...the **C# API instead matches the API of version 3.x of Godot**, not having the method of intersection with a ray, and returning for the `IntersectsSegment` method exclusively a boolean indicating whether it intersects or not, but not the value of the intersection point, as in its GDScript counterpart.

In summary:

- The GDScript public API for AABB class matches the one declared in the [documentation for Godot 4.x](https://docs.godotengine.org/es/4.x/classes/class_aabb.html#class-aabb-method-intersects-ray)
- The C# public API for AABB class matches the one declared in the [documentation for Godot 3.x ](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/3.6/classes/class_aabb.html#class-aabb-method-intersects-segment), **not the current version!** 

### Steps to reproduce

Declare an object of type AABB in a C# script. Simply access the public API through the editor. The API corresponds to the one declared in Godot version 3.x, not the current one.
Declare an object of type AABB in a GDScript script. When accessing the public API, it does correspond properly to the one declared in the Godot 4.x documentation.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
